hyperedges.label: On-prem forge ownership decision chain (ADR 0001 superseded by ADR 0002)
Hosting domain model: Forge, Home, Mirror, Mirror hub, Seed, Forge program
Pulumi deploy pipeline: CI pulumi job, Key Vault secrets, B2 backend, prod stack

nodes.label: Home
nodes.rationale: Exactly one Forge per repository where pushes, PRs and CI happen; avoid origin/primary/upstream.

nodes.label: Mirror
nodes.rationale: Read-only copy kept current from the Home; never takes pushes or PRs; private repositories have none.

nodes.label: Seed
nodes.rationale: Resolves the 'bootstrap repo' ambiguity: the Seed only prepares the Forge (org, program repositories, automation users, tokens) and declares no other repository.

nodes.label: Wayfinding operations (map, child tickets, blocking, frontier)
nodes.norm_label: wayfinding operations (map, child tickets, blocking, frontier)
nodes.rationale: Native GitHub issue dependencies are the canonical blocking representation; frontier is read in map order from sub-issues, not gh issue list.

nodes.label: ADR 0001: The on-prem Seed only prepares the forge
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001: the on-prem seed only prepares the forge
nodes.rationale: Superseded. Kept Home and Mirrors declared together in vcs; letting the Seed grow would split a codebase's declaration across programs and leave Mirror hub wiring without a single owner.

nodes.label: ADR 0002: The Forge program declares every repository with an on-prem copy
nodes.norm_label: adr 0002: the forge program declares every repository with an on-prem copy
nodes.rationale: unmango/scm had begun managing the forge directly, giving it two owners; one program owning everything on the forge, with the Seed handling only prerequisites, gives the forge one owner and keeps IaC hosted where its repositories live.

nodes.label: Domain docs consumption rules
nodes.rationale: Proceed silently if CONTEXT.md or ADRs are missing; /domain-modeling creates them lazily.

nodes.label: GitHub Issues tracker via gh CLI
nodes.norm_label: github issues tracker via gh cli

nodes.label: Repository placement rule (vcs vs unmango/scm vs Forge program)
nodes.norm_label: repository placement rule (vcs vs unmango/scm vs forge program)
nodes.rationale: A repository with no on-prem copy stays in vcs (gitlab.com Home) or its GitHub owner's program; any repository with an on-prem copy is declared in the Forge program.

nodes.label: Thin Seed option
nodes.rationale: Cost: the Seed's own repository is the one repository vcs doesn't declare, with no GitHub Mirror.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph (graphify-out/)
nodes.rationale: Agents read GRAPH_REPORT.md and query the graph before exploring; PRs that change code or docs rebuild and commit the graph.

nodes.label: check-pulumi-plugins
nodes.rationale: Every plugin is on PATH from nix, so a version the SDKs no longer ask for would be used silently; fail before touching the backend.

nodes.label: CI workflow
nodes.rationale: One concurrency group per PR cancels superseded runs after a restack; pushes to main key on the SHA so every merged commit gets a full run.

nodes.label: Read secrets from Key Vault step
nodes.norm_label: read secrets from key vault step
nodes.rationale: Secrets are written to GITHUB_ENV with a per-value random heredoc delimiter so a newline in a secret cannot inject extra env entries.

nodes.label: pulumi job (preview on PR, up on main)
nodes.norm_label: pulumi job (preview on pr, up on main)

nodes.label: gitlab/ group directory tree
nodes.rationale: One directory per GitLab group with group.ts and index.ts; a commented-out group and its ancestors must be uncommented or the file will not typecheck.

nodes.label: Raw gh.Repository with protect: true
nodes.rationale: A raw gh.Repository is a root-level resource, so an already-existing GitHub repo can be imported without a parent URN; components create the repository as a child and expose no adoption option.

nodes.label: Verify with tsc --noEmit and pulumi preview --diff
nodes.norm_label: verify with tsc --noemit and pulumi preview --diff

nodes.label: unmango Cachix cache
nodes.rationale: Provides prebuilt github and gitlab provider plugins; without it every run rebuilds both from source.

nodes.label: add-repo skill
nodes.rationale: The repository name is the only required input; every other field is prompted with a generated default so entries match the live repo.

nodes.label: Create vs import (pulumi import with parent URN)
nodes.norm_label: create vs import (pulumi import with parent urn)
nodes.rationale: An existing resource must be imported first or pulumi up fails on a name conflict; the command depends on the resource's place in the URN tree, read from pulumi stack export.

nodes.label: Generated default rules (category, visibility, component, requiredChecks)
nodes.norm_label: generated default rules (category, visibility, component, requiredchecks)

nodes.label: GitLab path shortening
nodes.rationale: The GitLab group already carries the category context, so the redundant prefix/suffix is stripped from path.

nodes.label: Registry-locked names
nodes.rationale: terraform-provider-* and NuGet package IDs are never shortened because registries bind to the full name.

nodes.label: pulumi-prod concurrency group with queue: max
nodes.norm_label: pulumi-prod concurrency group with queue: max
nodes.rationale: Only up needs the global stack lock; queue: max releases pending runs FIFO so merging a stack of N PRs does not silently drop intermediate commits, unlike the default single queue.

nodes.label: Classic PAT for GitHub Mirrors
nodes.rationale: GitHub App installation tokens cannot create repositories under the UnstoppableMango user account.

nodes.label: Home move procedure (import, state rm, zero deletes)
nodes.norm_label: home move procedure (import, state rm, zero deletes)
nodes.rationale: Import into the Forge program, then remove from vcs state without deleting (unprotect first); both previews must show zero deletes.

nodes.label: pulumi token via Key Vault and ExternalSecret
nodes.norm_label: pulumi token via key vault and externalsecret
nodes.rationale: A StackReference would require a shared passphrase, letting anything that runs the Forge program decrypt the Seed's state.
